create_optimizer_subclass: create a subclass of BaseOptimizer that implements the optimizer property and optimizer_config property
set_learning_rate: set the learning rate across all param groups using the set_lr method on a BaseOptimizer instance
clip_gradient_norm: clip the gradient norm of all optimizer parameters using clip_grad_norm with a max_norm value
load_optimizer_checkpoint: load an optimizer state dict from a checkpoint with optional overrides using load_state_dict
perform_optimization_step: perform a single optimization step with optional scale factor and param groups using the step method
